comment: Libraries from ../versions.json that apply to Apple but cannot be built without breaking a Mediahro policy. Each needs an orchestrator/owner decision (STATUS.md section 3). build.sh does not build them and the archive manifest does not list them; delete the entry once the decision lands and add the recipe.

libraries.name: libssh2
libraries.reason: libssh2 has no Apple OS-crypto backend (its backends are OpenSSL, wolfSSL, libgcrypt, mbedTLS, WinCNG, OS400QC3). docs/05 4.1 and docs/07 rule 12 require OS crypto only and forbid shipping OpenSSL/mbedTLS; wolfSSL is GPL. SFTP on iOS/macOS needs an ADR: e.g. accept mbedTLS for SSH only (encryption inventory + ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption review, owner/legal) or implement SFTP over Network.framework + CryptoKit in the app.

libraries.name: openscreen-libcast
libraries.reason: Open Screen's Cast sender (TLS channel and certificate verification in cast/common/certificate) is written against BoringSSL, an OpenSSL fork, and builds only with Chromium's gclient/GN toolchain. Shipping it breaks the no-OpenSSL / OS-crypto rule (docs/05 4.1, docs/07 rule 12). Needs an ADR: e.g. a Network.framework + Security.framework platform TLS/crypto adapter for libcast, or Google Cast iOS SDK in store flavours with a different FOSS-flavour sender.
